gripOrHq.title: The Shell Traders
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

gripOrHq.title: Priority Wreck
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Evil Twin
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[3]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or brain damage total each turn.

gripOrHq.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Armored Fridge
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Anonymous Tip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Derez a piece of black ice of your choice.

heapOrArchives.title: If You Want It Done Right...
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

heapOrArchives.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

heapOrArchives.title: Skivviss
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Code Viral Cache
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. If the Corp forgoes actions to lose Virus counters, two counters of your choice are not removed. The Corp may trash Code Viral Cache by taking an action to pay [5].

heapOrArchives.title: Lucidrine™ Booster Drug
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run, and gain [9], which you may use only during that run. After that run is completed, suffer 1 brain damage; this damage cannot be prevented. Then, return to the bank any of the [9] not spent.

heapOrArchives.title: HQ Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

scoreArea.title: Artificial Security Directors
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Black Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

rig.title: Jackhammer
rig.rulesText:
[0]: Break wall subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Jackhammer, lose 1 credit, if you can, from a stealth card.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Skivviss
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

scoreArea.title: AI Chief Financial Officer
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Shuffle cards stored in HQ and the Archives into R&D; then draw five cards.

ice.title: Hunter

ice.title: Data Raven
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag and a Data Raven counter. Each Data Raven counter gives Runner a tag at the start of each Runner turn. Runner may remove a Data Raven counter by taking an action to pay [1].
